function.heroSubtitle: Explore all the capabilities that make File Translator the smartest choice for document translation.
function.excelDesc: Translate Excel spreadsheets with full structure preservation. Select specific cells, ranges, or entire worksheets for batch translation.
function.excelP2: Cell range selection with colon syntax (e.g. A:D)
function.wordDesc: Translate Word documents while preserving all formatting — bold, italic, colors, highlights, and tables remain intact.
function.pptDesc: Translate presentations slide by slide. Text boxes, shapes, and layouts are preserved — your slides look exactly as designed.
function.pptP1: Text box and shape content translation
function.pdfDirectDesc: Directly translate PDF documents without conversion. Support for text, tables, and images within PDF files.
function.pdfConvDesc: Convert PDF to editable formats first, then translate with full control. Ideal for complex layouts and scanned documents.
function.ocrDesc: Extract and translate text from images. Supports screenshots, photos, and scanned documents with built-in OCR technology.
function.termDesc: Build and manage custom glossaries for consistent professional translation. Right-click to add terms, batch import/export supported.
function.miscDesc: Custom color themes, model selection, auto network detection, file format validation, user preference memory, and more thoughtful touches.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms

sections.title: 4. Intellectual Property

sections.title: 5. AI Translation Disclaimer

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
paragraphs: When you create an account, we collect your name and email address.
We automatically collect information about how you interact with the Service, including feature usage, file types translated, and error logs.
Documents you upload for translation are processed temporarily and are not permanently stored on our servers after translation is complete.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use the collected information to:
list: Communicate with you about updates and support
Detect and prevent technical issues or abuse

sections.title: 3. Data Processing & Third-Party AI Models
paragraphs: File Translator integrates with third-party AI models (such as DeepSeek, GLM, Qwen, and OpenAI). When you submit a translation request, the document content is transmitted to the selected AI provider for processing. Each provider has its own privacy policy, and we encourage you to review them.

sections.title: 4. Data Retention
paragraphs: Uploaded documents are processed in memory and are not stored on our servers after the translation session ends. Account information is retained as long as your account is active. Usage analytics data is retained for up to 12 months.

sections.title: 5. Data Security
paragraphs: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest where applicable. However, no method of electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights
paragraphs: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
To exercise these rights, contact us at support@translatech.com.
list: Access the personal data we hold about you
Request correction or deletion of your data
Object to or restrict certain processing activities

sections.title: 7. Cookies
paragraphs: The Service may use essential cookies for session management and preference storage. We do not use tracking cookies for advertising purposes. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though this may affect functionality.

sections.title: 8. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: The Service is not intended for individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.title: 9. International Data Transfers
paragraphs: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. We take appropriate safeguards to ensure your data remains protected.

sections.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the effective date.

sections.title: 11. Contact
paragraphs: For privacy-related inquiries, contact us at support@translatech.com.
